methods.name: place
methods.body: const axis=this.axis;const size=axis=="x"?"width":"height";const kids=this.laid();const weight=c=>{const f=c.flexes;return f===true?1:typeof f=="number"&&f>0?f:0};const shrinking=c=>weight(c)==0&&c.shrinks===true;const flexing=c=>weight(c)>0||shrinking(c);const minKey=axis=="x"?"minWidth":"minHeight";const maxKey=axis=="x"?"maxWidth":"maxHeight";const clamp=(c,v)=>{const hi=c[maxKey];const lo=c[minKey];const capped=hi>0?Math.min(v,hi):v;return Math.max(capped,lo)};const given=kids.map(c=>0);let flexN=0;let shrinkN=0;let visN=0;let fixed=0;kids.forEach((c,i)=>{if(!c.visible)return;visN=visN+1;if(weight(c)>0){flexN=flexN+1;given[i]=clamp(c,0)}else if(shrinking(c)){shrinkN=shrinkN+1;given[i]=clamp(c,c[axis=="x"?"contentWidth":"contentHeight"])}else fixed=fixed+c.footprint()[size]});if(flexN+shrinkN>0){fixed=fixed+this.spacing*Math.max(0,visN-1);const own=flexN>0?this.contentExtent(size):this.viewExtent(size);const room=flexN==0&&own<=0?Infinity:own;let used=fixed;kids.forEach((c,i)=>{used=used+given[i]});const held=kids.map(c=>false);if(used>room){let over=used-room;for(let round=0;round<=kids.length;round=round+1){let basis=0;kids.forEach((c,i)=>{if(c.visible&&shrinking(c)&&!held[i])basis=basis+given[i]});if(basis<=0)break;let again=false;kids.forEach((c,i)=>{if(!c.visible||!shrinking(c)||held[i])return;const lo=c[minKey];if(given[i]-over*given[i]/basis<lo){over=over-(given[i]-lo);given[i]=lo;held[i]=true;again=true}});if(!again){kids.forEach((c,i)=>{if(c.visible&&shrinking(c)&&!held[i])given[i]=given[i]-over*given[i]/basis});break}}}else if(flexN>0){let free=room-fixed;kids.forEach((c,i)=>{if(c.visible&&shrinking(c))free=free-given[i]});for(let round=0;round<=kids.length;round=round+1){let total=0;kids.forEach((c,i)=>{if(c.visible&&weight(c)>0&&!held[i])total=total+weight(c)});if(total<=0)break;const each=Math.max(0,free)/total;let off=0;kids.forEach((c,i)=>{if(!c.visible||weight(c)==0||held[i])return;const want=each*weight(c);given[i]=clamp(c,want);off=off+given[i]-want});if(Math.abs(off)<.001)break;kids.forEach((c,i)=>{if(!c.visible||weight(c)==0||held[i])return;const want=each*weight(c);if(off>0&&given[i]>want||off<0&&given[i]<want){held[i]=true;free=free-given[i]}})}}}const al=this.align;const cross=axis=="x"?"y":"x";const crossSize=axis=="x"?"height":"width";const crossOf=c=>{if(flexing(c))return{lead:0,extent:c[crossSize]};const fc=c.footprint();return{lead:axis=="x"?fc.y:fc.x,extent:fc[crossSize]}};let line=0;let lineBase=0;const natural=axis=="x"?"contentHeight":"contentWidth";const extentOf=c=>al=="stretch"&&this.sizedByContent(c,crossSize)?c[natural]:crossOf(c).extent;if(al!="none"){if(al=="baseline"&&axis!="x")this.refuseStackBaseline();for(const c of kids){if(!c.visible)continue;line=Math.max(line,extentOf(c));const b=c.baseline;if(al=="baseline"&&typeof b=="number")lineBase=Math.max(lineBase,b)}if(al=="center"||al=="end")line=Math.max(line,this.viewExtent(crossSize));else if(al=="stretch"){const band=this.viewExtent(crossSize);if(band>0)line=band}}let pos=0;return kids.map((c,i)=>{const flex=c.visible&&flexing(c);const f=flex?null:c.footprint();const lead=f==null?0:axis=="x"?f.x:f.y;const box=axis=="x"?{x:pos-lead}:{y:pos-lead};if(flex)box[axis=="x"?"w":"h"]=given[i];if(al!="none"){const co=crossOf(c);const leadC=co.lead;let off=0;if(al=="center")off=(line-co.extent)/2;else if(al=="end")off=line-co.extent;else if(al=="baseline"&&axis=="x"){const b=c.baseline;if(typeof b=="number")off=lineBase-b;else if(c.visible)this.refuseBaseline(c)}box[cross]=off-(al=="baseline"?0:leadC);if(al=="stretch")box.stretch=axis=="x"?{h:line}:{w:line}}if(c.visible)pos=pos+(flex?given[i]:f[size])+this.spacing;return box})
